description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
summary: I like that Voicebox collapses the full voice I/O loop—Whisper-based dictation on the input side, eight TTS engines on the output side—into one local Tauri binary with an MCP server bolted on, so any agent session I'm already driving through AgentOn Pocket or routing through PenguPool can call `voicebox_speak` and get spoken feedback in a cloned voice without phoning home to ElevenLabs. The practical win for me is the global dictation hotkey piped through a bundled local LLM for refinement; it kills the typing tax when I'm iterating on code or notes, and nothing leaves the machine. The multi-track stories editor and paralinguistic tags are fun, but the MCP tool-call surface is what turns this from a neat demo into a composable piece I can wire into an existing agent pipeline.
